newsitem.title: USA: Fisher gets leveraged recap bid from Trinity.
newsitem.headline: Fisher gets leveraged recap bid from Trinity.

text.p: Trinity I Fund L.P. said Thursday it is willing to launch a "leveraged recapitalization" of Fisher Scientific International Inc valuing Fisher "perhaps in the range of $47 to $48 per share," according to a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing.

If Fisher's board does not agree to the recap proposal Trinity would be willing to discuss a "more conventional acquisition transaction, structured as a cash merger (possibly in combination with a tender offer) in which all shareholders would be paid under the recapitalization proposal," according to the filing.
